refused_program.body:

preconditions.probe:
current=$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD) || exit 1
remote=$(git config --get "branch.$current.remote") || exit 1
merge=$(git config --get "branch.$current.merge") || exit 1
test "$remote" = "{upstream_remote}"
test "$merge" != "refs/heads/{upstream_branch}"
test "${merge#refs/heads/}" != "$merge"
old=${merge#refs/heads/}
git ls-remote --exit-code --heads "{upstream_remote}" "$old" >/dev/null
test $? -eq 2
